NyEllerFortsettSoknad.title: Application for financial assistance
NyEllerFortsettSoknad.fortsettSoknadTitle: Continue an application you have started

dialog.avsnitt1: Financial assistance is temporary support when you are unable to cover necessary expenses yourself.
dialog.avsnitt2: In the application, you will be asked to provide information about yourself and your situation. Please fill in the application as best you can.

forDuSoker.title: Before you apply
forDuSoker.tekst: See what may be useful to know before you apply, and which documentation we may ask for.

item1.title: Useful to know before you apply
item1.liste:
• Fill in the application as best you can, and state clearly what you need help or money for.
  • You can submit the application even if you have not uploaded any documentation. You may be asked to document some of the information you provide along the way.
  • Your answers are saved automatically while you fill in the application, so you can take breaks. You can also click Save application if you want to stop and continue later. Applications you have started are saved for 14 days.
  • Your application will be processed as quickly as possible.
item1.tekst: Want to know more? Read more about financial assistance (opens in a new tab).

item2.title: See examples of documentation we may ask for
item2.liste:
• Invoices/receipts for what you have applied for support for, such as rent and electricity
  • Tax return
  • Tax assessment notice
  • Payslip (if you are employed)
  • Account statement showing the balance of your accounts
  • Information about your housing situation (tenancy agreement)
item2.tekst: Documentation can be sent as documents, images or other file types.

personopplysninger.title: Collection and processing of personal data
personopplysninger.tekst: We automatically collect information from public registers. By clicking the Start application button at the bottom of the page, you agree to this.

item1.title: Information we collect about you
item1.p1: In addition to the information you provide in the application, we automatically collect the following information about you from other public registers when you start the application:
item1.liste:
• Citizenship, address and family relationships from the National Population Register
  • Bank account number
  • Telephone number from the Contact and Reservation Register
  • Employment relationships from the Employer and Employee Register
  • Payments from Nav
item1.p2: In the application, you can choose to consent to us collecting information about your income (from the Norwegian Tax Administration) and housing benefit from Husbanken.
item1.p3: You can read more about how Nav processes personal data (opens in a new tab)

item2.title: How we process personal data
item2.p1: We will process your personal data securely and correctly, and will not collect more information than is necessary.
item2.p2: You can read more about how we process personal data (opens in a new tab)

bekreftelse.tekst: It is important that you provide us with correct information so that we can process your case. Read more about the importance of providing correct information.

EttersendDokuPanel.title: Send documentation for an application you have submitted

text.p1: Documentation can be sent to applications you have previously submitted.
text.p2: Go to the list of <lenke>your social assistance applications</lenke>
text.p3: Open the application that you would like to forward documentation to
text.p4: Upload the documents you are going to send under “Your documents”

innhenting.title: Collecting and processing of personal data

text.p1: We automatically collect information from public registers. By pressing "Start application" you accept this.
text.p2: <lenke>Read more about collecting and processing of your personal data</lenke>.

nodsituasjon.title: Are you in an emergency situation?
nodsituasjon.text: If you do not have money for food or a place to stay for the next 24 hours, you should mention this in your application.

SokerUnder18Feilmelding.title: To apply for financial assistance, you must be at least 18 years old.
SokerUnder18Feilmelding.text1: If you are under 18, you must have consent from your guardians to apply for financial social assistance.
SokerUnder18Feilmelding.text2: If you want to know more about consent or have questions about how this works, you can contact <lenke>your local Nav office</lenke> where you live or stay, or call us at <phone>55 55 33 33</phone>.

PersonbeskyttelseFeilmelding.title: Sorry
PersonbeskyttelseFeilmelding.text: Unfortunately, you cannot use the digital application for financial assistance. Contact your local <lenke>Nav office</lenke> to receive help applying.

soknadKanIkkeSendes.infotekst: A technical error occurred, and your application was not submitted. We recommend that you delete the application and start a new one. We’re sorry for the inconvenience.

TrengerDuRaskHjelp.title: Do you need immediate help?
TrengerDuRaskHjelp.kontaktKontoret: If you do not have money for necessary things such as food, you must contact your Nav office. Nav will also help you to find a temporary place of residence if you have nowhere to sleep or to stay in the next 24 hours.
TrengerDuRaskHjelp.papirAlternativ: You can also <lenke>apply for financial assistance on paper</lenke> at your Nav office.
TrengerDuRaskHjelp.lenkeTilHovedmeny: Go to the front page for financial assistance
